> This is a demo website built by NorthWeb.co for the Food & Beverage industry.

## What this site is
Restaurant & Cafe is a professionally designed demo website showcasing how a food & beverage business can look online. It was built by NorthWeb.co (yourdomain.com) as part of their client portfolio of web design services.

## Tagline
Delight your guests before they even walk through the door

## Description
A beautiful restaurant website with digital menu, photo gallery, table reservations, and Google Maps.

## Industry
Food & Beverage

## Key Features
- Digital Menu: Beautiful menu with photos, prices, and veg/non-veg/allergen labels.
- Table Reservations: Online booking with instant confirmation via WhatsApp.
- Food Gallery: Mouth-watering photography that drives footfall.
- Find Us: Embedded Google Maps, parking info, and opening hours.
- Dietary Info: Clear allergen, vegan, and Jain food labels on every dish.
- Google Reviews: Showcase your best reviews to build trust with new diners.
